chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Zayd ibn Aslam, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'When you enter a land, eat from its onions, so that it may dispel its plague from you.'
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about eating onions to prevent plague?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi’s chapter on onions, this hadith links the consumption of local produce to warding off 'wabā' (plague or miasma), reflecting the Shia emphasis on practical prophetic medicine (al-ṭibb al-nabawī). It underscores the belief that dietary habits serve as both physical protection and spiritual purification when traversing new regions, a concept deeply rooted in early Islamic medical traditions.
